name: nnbot
description: Lightweight QQ Bot with plugin system

scripts.copy:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');function c(s,d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const sp=p.join(s,f),dp=p.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory())c(sp,dp);else fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}c('src/webui/public','dist/webui/public')"
